title: Your Turkey Timer Is Lying: We Fixed Thanksgiving Dinner With Science
description:
The little red pop-up button is the reason your turkey is dry. Blue hosts Thanksgiving for the first time, refuses to read a recipe, and gets corrected on everything: the turkey, thawing, stuffing, pumpkin pie, gravy, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, and the post-dinner crash.

0:00 The button lied
0:37 Chapter 1: The Turkey
3:25 Chapter 2: The Night Before
4:54 Chapter 3: The Pie
6:22 Chapter 4: The Sides
7:45 Chapter 5: The Crash

Sources: USDA FSIS (safe temps, thawing, stuffing), King Arthur Baking (custard pies, blind baking), America's Test Kitchen (mashed potatoes), USDA FoodData Central (tryptophan), Calorie Control Council (meal calories).

#Thanksgiving #CookingScience #Turkey
